title: hieracium subcrassum
intro: Hieracium subcrassum, commonly known as Rough Hawk's-beard, is a perennial plant species belonging to the dandelion family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits, such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may contribute to the relief of digestive issues and skin problems. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium subcrassum include its potential to modulate the immune system, exhibit antimicrobial properties, and serve as a natural diuretic. The bioactive constituents of this plant are believed to include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpene lactones, although more research is necessary to confirm its full range of bioactive compounds.
